limitation: Run 1 partly measured without VPN
description: 41 measurements from run 1 were taken without VPN from a location in Germany. All ChatGPT rows were re-measured under the final condition (VPN exit Frankfurt). Gemini's location dependence was only observed on 3 September; the affected run-1 rows were deliberately not replaced, to avoid turning run 1 into a mixed dataset from two days. The column location_vpn shows the condition per row.

limitation: Gemini is location-dependent
description: On 3 September 2026 Gemini showed its own map block for the first time. Whether VPN or a product update caused it is unclear. Location-related Gemini results from run 1 are therefore only partly comparable with later measurements.

limitation: ChatGPT usage limit active
description: In six measurements ChatGPT reported a reached usage limit. An effect on answer quality is not evidenced; for D06 and E12 ChatGPT still returned complete provider lists.

limitation: Tool vendors recorded only from 3 September
scope: 67 of 155 run-1 measurements without tool data
description: Separate recording of software tools started on 3 September 2026. Tool frequencies refer to measurements with recorded tool data, not to all measurements. Agency counts are not affected.

limitation: Missing source list added from platform history
description: For one Perplexity measurement the source list was missing from the first export. It was added completely from the platform history on 4 September 2026; the measurement itself was unchanged.

limitation: Gemini shows sources as display names without URL
description: Source capture for Gemini is systematically incomplete because the interface shows display names without URLs. Domain frequencies should therefore be read per platform, not as a combined total.

limitation: GCC block measured without a UAE exit
description: The GCC block was measured from Germany. The map block for E12 still showed Dubai: the prompt wording steers the region more than the IP. The block is not distorted by this, but comparing it with a later measurement from the UAE would be a change of condition.

limitation: No Arabic prompt in the set
description: Bilingual Arabic/English communication is the market standard in the GCC, but the prompt set contains no Arabic prompt. GCC results therefore only cover the English-speaking part of the market.

limitation: Perplexity in preview mode throughout
description: Measured with 'Pro / extended search (preview)'. A product change during the study period would be logged as a change of condition.

limitation: A/B delivery of answer variants (ChatGPT and Gemini)
description: ChatGPT and Gemini each offered two answer variants in one measurement, differing in the providers named. The first variant is counted throughout. The case also shows that the same request at the same moment can produce different provider lists.

limitation: Ads in ChatGPT
description: In 26 cases ChatGPT showed ads below the answer, several explicitly labelled as ads and several off-topic. Ads do not count as a mention.

limitation: 33 discarded measurements outside the prompt set
description: On 3 September 2026, 33 measurements were taken with wordings that are not part of the frozen set. They are not included in this dataset and in no metric. One of them contained a Grovia citation, which is therefore not counted.

limitation: Runs 4 and 5 completed
description: As of 9 September 2026 all 525 measurements are recorded and runs 1 to 5 are complete.

limitation: Two averages for 'providers per answer'
description: The average number of named providers is 5.46 across all answers and 8.38 across answers with at least one provider. Both are reported separately.

limitation: Source rows from discarded measurements
description: Seven source rows from the measurements discarded on 3 September were wrongly filed under valid measurement IDs. They are excluded from this dataset.

limitation: One source not captured for E06-CHA-2
description: For one ChatGPT measurement the link to the first-named provider was not exported. Provider counts are not affected; the source list of this measurement is incomplete by one entry.

limitation: Source rows from replaced earlier versions
description: Five ChatGPT measurements from run 1 were re-taken on 3 September 2026 with corrected wording. The source rows of the replaced versions are excluded from this dataset, which only contains sources of the 525 valid measurements.

limitation: Memory features active in Perplexity and Gemini
description: During part of the baseline, Perplexity's 'use search history' and 'notes' and Gemini's 'saved info' were active, so runs were not fully independent. Perplexity stored exactly one entry ('the user owns a brand'); no agency, competitor or topic content. An effect is evidenced for D13-PER-3 and D12-PER-3. Against a strong effect: for D11, D12 and D13 the three Perplexity runs share zero providers. Gemini's channel is broader because it uses the whole chat history; near-identical Gemini answers for D11 and D12 cannot be separated from memory effects. Perplexity stability values should be read as an upper bound. Both options were switched off on 4 September 2026 after D13 (D01–D13 with memory, D14–E20 without). ChatGPT memory and personalisation were off throughout.

limitation: ChatGPT in normal instead of temporary chats
description: The plan specified temporary chats; a new, empty but saved chat was used per prompt. Context transfer is excluded because personalisation from past chats was disabled throughout (screenshot evidence). Disclosed for completeness.

limitation: Control-group design fixed after the baseline
description: The control-group design was fixed after the baseline and before the first measure (decided 8 September 2026, first measure 10 September 2026): measures are introduced in a staggered way, and what is not yet treated serves as comparison. For globally acting measures such as directories or press there is no prompt control group, only time-based control via the pulse. The baseline itself is not affected.

limitation: First measure before all prerequisites were complete
description: The first measure (M1, 10 September 2026) was carried out before the control measurements and two of three baseline data pulls were complete. The baseline itself was complete at that point. The affected pull was repeated; over 95 percent of its reference period lies before the intervention.

limitation: No Arabic version of the website
description: At baseline the website existed only in German and English. If an effect in the GCC block stays absent, the missing Arabic version is a possible cause that cannot be separated from other measures. Arabic content was deliberately not created because the provider does not deliver services in Arabic.

limitation: Unsupported visibility claim on the website during the baseline
description: During the baseline the page /performance-marketing/ contained unsupported claims about the agency's own AI visibility, visible to crawlers ('Verified in Gemini & GPT-4o', 'AI Citations Created 12k+', 'GEO Success Rate 98%'). An influence is neither evidenced nor excluded; the baseline found no mention despite these claims. Removed on 13 September 2026 (measure M1e).

limitation: Control measurement for limitation 18 not evaluable
description: The control measurements were complete but not evaluable: conditions A and B differ not only in the memory setting but also in date. Runs 4 and 5 on 8 September already ran without memory and show the same overlap (0.49) as memory runs (0.45), while the 13 September runs show 0.77, so the difference cannot come from memory. All 21 control measurements ran within 72 minutes, which can understate variance. Whether memory affects stability remains unresolved. Consequence: the time of day is a mandatory field from now on.

limitation: Category drift between agencies and tools
description: Assigning a provider to 'agency' or 'tool' varies. One provider was recorded once as an agency and once as a tool for the same prompt on the same day. Agency and tool counts should not be read as sharp categories.

limitation: Physical location tested for the first time on 13 September 2026
description: The plan declares the physical location irrelevant as long as the VPN exit Frankfurt is active. This was tested for the first time on 13 September 2026 from the United Arab Emirates with VPN exit Frankfurt and German system settings: both platforms located the session in Germany. Since only one combination was tested, the physical location is logged per measurement series from now on.

limitation: Pulse results only comparable with runs 1–3 of the baseline
description: Pulses use three runs per prompt and platform, the baseline five. Three runs make answers look more stable than they are: after three runs 49 of 105 prompt-platform rows had a stable core, after five only 37. Pulse results are therefore only compared with runs 1 to 3 of the baseline.

limitation: Name collisions with unrelated companies
description: Several unrelated companies use identical or similar names, including two in the same field (groviadigital.com, an SEO agency, and groviadigi.in). Mentions are only counted if they clearly refer to Grovia Management Consultancy L.L.C; ambiguous cases are not counted and are reported separately. The case did not occur in the baseline.

limitation: Sources not recorded although marked as captured
description: For these answers the protocol marks sources as captured, but no source rows were recorded. They are marked 'not recorded' and excluded from source analyses.
